CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW v_high_risk_donors AS
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.contrib_registry AS donor_id,
    d.age_count AS age,
    CASE
        WHEN mh.med_history LIKE '%Cancer%' THEN 'Cancer'
        WHEN mh.smk_cond LIKE '%Current smoker%' THEN 'Current smoker'
        WHEN mh.alc_cond LIKE '%Heavy use%' THEN 'Heavy alcohol use'
        WHEN mh.drug_cond LIKE '%Current use%' THEN 'Current drug use'
    END AS risk_factor
FROM demographics d
JOIN medical_history mh ON d.contrib_registry = mh.contrib_med_registry
WHERE mh.med_history LIKE '%Cancer%'
   OR mh.smk_cond LIKE '%Current smoker%'
   OR mh.alc_cond LIKE '%Heavy use%'
   OR mh.drug_cond LIKE '%Current use%';
